Name: Compatibility Patches for Bog's Forest UI
Author: Alixolotle
Description:
With permission from BogWyytch and other mod authors, I made some compatibility patches for select mods that I use to match with Bog's Forest UI! I don't like having non matching assets with select mods, so I decided to make some with this UI and share 'em with others of their choice.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿


﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ [b][u]*BE AWARE THAT I AM COLORBLIND. IF SOME STUFF LOOKS OFF, DO LET ME KNOW AND ILL TRY TO FIX IF I CAN* 
[/u][/b]
﻿
